data.one_liner: A GridView widget that groups list items and supports headers and footers per section.
data.what_it_does: Provides a GridView implementation allowing developers to group items into sections with custom headers and footers, mimicking iOS UICollectionView sections. It exposes standard GridView builder capabilities.
use_when: You need to display grid items organized in distinct sections with headers or footers.
You want a grid layout similar to iOS UICollectionView sections in Flutter.
avoid_when: You need standard linear lists instead of grids (consider a grouped list view instead).
You require complex staggered grid patterns not natively supported by standard grid delegates.
strengths: Supports section headers and footers for grouped grid items.
Compatible with standard GridView builders and delegates.
Cross-platform support including Android, iOS, Web, Windows, macOS, and Linux.
weaknesses: Limited documentation beyond basic README examples.
No advanced community-driven features or frequent updates mentioned in changelog.

alternatives.name: flutter_staggered_grid_view
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick if you need complex staggered grid layouts with varying item sizes instead of standard grid sections.
